citations.text: M. Hoefer (2003). Experimental comparison of heuristic and approximation algorithms for uncapacitated facility location. Experimental and Efficient Algorithms (WEA 2003), LNCS 2647, 165-178.
M. Körkel (1989). On the exact solution of large-scale simple plant location problems. European Journal of Operational Research 39(2), 157-173.
D. Ghosh (2003). Neighborhood search heuristics for the uncapacitated facility location problem. European Journal of Operational Research 150(1), 150-162.

description: UflLib's Koerkel-Ghosh asymmetric package: 45 instances of the three largest sizes of Ghosh (2003), 250, 500 and 750 facilities and as many cities, connection costs drawn from 1,000 to 2,000 in a asymmetric matrix and opening costs in three classes, with an optimal or best found solution for each.
name: UflLib Koerkel-Ghosh asymmetric

properties.referenceValues: the .opt (optimal) or .bub (best found) file beside each instance in the package, whose last number is the solution's cost and whose others name each city's facility, numbered from 0
